messages:
maria_docs: Heads up — found a cluster of 'crumbs' tags in the KB that don't map to owners, looks like stale-link risk. quick sweep this week? :mag:

alex_w: Thanks — can you paste the query you used? I'll run a pass for runtime docs.

maria_docs: Sure, used ripgrep across the content repo:
```
ripgrep "#crumbs|\[CRUMBS\]" docs/ -n
```
Most hits are in /kb/ and /runtime-guide. Only ~18 hits, mostly images pointing to old CDN.

josh: I can handle images rehost + PRs for 6 files. Tag me on the PRs.

kevin: I'll take ownership pings for any doc that currently has no owner frontmatter. Also can add a small script to append `owner: docs-team` if blank (will open PR for the automation first).

maria_docs: Perfect — can we coordinate so we don't step on each other's PRs? Suggest we create a single tracking PR with a checklist and small commits per doc.

sara: fwiw, I saw a broken internal link in onboarding that points to /runtime/old-api — I can fix that while I'm in there.

docs-bot: Automated link-scan found 4 new 404s in staging yesterday; created issue #4283.

alex_w: ok, plan: josh does image rehost PRs, sara fixes onboarding link, kevin does ownership frontmatter PR, maria opens tracking PR with list. I'll run CI link-check after each PR.

maria_docs: timeline: can we aim to have PRs opened by EOD Fri? If anyone needs more time, say so.

josh: EOD Fri works.

sara: might need extra day — but will open WIP PR and mark it draft by Friday.

kevin: can do EOD Fri.

maria_docs: great — tagging @platform-team for FYI on CDN rehosts in case of cache changes.

alex_w: thanks all :thumbsup: 

maria_docs: I'll drop the list here in a sec and include the ripgrep hits and a link to issue #4283.
